# Odonto House

> Odonto House is a dental clinic in Guayaquil, Ecuador, for international patients, mainly from the United States. It offers porcelain veneers (Smile Design / Hollywood Smile) and dental implants at average prices up to 70% below typical US prices. The lead dentist, Dr. Elena Barroso, speaks fluent English. The clinic offers airport pickup and its own guest suites.

## Key facts

- Location: Av. las Aguas 1106 entre Jiguas y Laureles, Guayaquil, Ecuador
- Nearest airport: José Joaquín de Olmedo International Airport (GYE), Guayaquil
- Lead dentist: Dr. Elena Barroso, over 10 years of experience in aesthetic dentistry, fluent in English and Spanish
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Prices are in US dollars (Ecuador uses the US dollar)
- Payment: international credit cards, Zelle, cash and wire transfer
- Free virtual consultation before travelling; the final price is given after the consultation
- Implant brands: Straumann and Nobel Biocare. Veneers: Emax porcelain
- Contact: WhatsApp +593 99 090 4443

## Average prices (USD, compared with typical US prices)

- Porcelain veneer (Emax): $350 per tooth (US: about $1,500)
- Hollywood Smile, 10-12 veneers: $4,200 (US: about $18,000)
- Single dental implant: $950 (US: about $4,500)
- All-on-4 implants: $8,500 per arch (US: about $28,000)
- All-on-6 implants: $12,000 per arch (US: about $35,000)
- Zirconia crown: $400 per tooth (US: about $1,800)
- Invisalign / clear aligners: $2,200 (US: about $6,000)
- Laser teeth whitening: $250 per session (US: about $800)
- Root canal: $300 per tooth (US: about $1,200)

## Treatment time

- Smile Design with veneers: most cases take 3 to 5 days in Guayaquil
- Dental implants: usually two trips, one to place the implants and one for the final teeth after healing (often 3 to 6 months); the exact plan is confirmed in the consultation

## All-Inclusive Smile Design Package

10-12 porcelain veneers, a suite at the clinic for the whole treatment, 3 meals a day, airport pickup and drop-off, a Guayaquil city tour, concierge service and all follow-up visits during the stay.
